programs.title: Cheese Slices
programs.desc: Making Cheese in Ireland dates back to Celtic times, but surprisingly it's only in the past decade that artisan cheese makers have revived the ancient art of traditional cheese making. Will explores the spectacularly rugged South West coast, and discovers a great selection of washed rind cheeses, blue cheese, and an unusual cheese flavoured with seaweed.

programs.title: Buddy Valastro's Cake Dynasty
programs.desc: Work collides with family life when Buddy must create a magic-themed birthday cake for Neil Patrick Harris on the same week as Junior's prom and graduation.

programs.title: Destination Flavour Singapore Bitesize
programs.desc: The best bits of Adam Liaw's travels in Singapore, as he explores its vibrant food scene.

programs.title: Maneet's Eats
programs.desc: Chef Maneet Chauhan makes chicken biryani with layers of marinated chicken, herbs, rice, saffron milk, cashews, golden raisins and much more.

programs.title: Mary Berry's Cook & Share
programs.desc: Dame Mary Berry rediscovers Bristol. As well as sharing delicious dishes from shakshuka to pear & blueberry galette she samples a Michelin star menu & tries her hand at street art.

programs.title: Eva Longoria: Searching For Mexico
programs.desc: Galicia is Spain's best kept secret, so remote and wild the Romans thought it was the end of the world - yet so rich in natural resources and landscapes that its produce is truly out of this world.
